About me.

I combine web engineering with experience in applied machine learning research.

I earned a B.S. in Computer Science with a Mathematics minor from Missouri State University in December 2025. My work spans client web platforms, clinical documentation software, and transformer research for time series forecasting.

As president of Missouri State’s ACM chapter, I organized workshops, technical talks, and career events, helping increase engagement by 50%.
